title: ingress rule says episode-shaped writes only; every real ingest uses free-Turtle /knot
description: docs/design/ingress.md rule 1: every camayoc ingress goes through /episode (prov:wasGeneratedBy supplied, idempotent, no free-Turtle writes to governed planes). Reality: the only /episode calls in the repo are the four deliberately-invalid bootstrap probes; every successful ingest is POST /knot (bootstrap.sh:143, seed_knowledge.sh:61, reconcile_metrics.sh:33, tests). prov:wasGeneratedBy appears nowhere outside the design doc. Either move real ingest to /episode or narrow rule 1 to the planes it actually governs.

title: gate proofs live only in the installer: no refusal tests, not in CI, probe grep defects
description: The untagged-write and falsifier refusals are proven only by scripts/bootstrap.sh probes (158-231). tests/test_metrics_slice.py has no negative arm; CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs markdownlint only. Two probe defects: (a) the grep at bootstrap.sh:163 matches curl stderr ('Connection refused' satisfies 'refus'), so a network failure can read as PROVEN; (b) the falsifier arm's probe body contains the word 'falsifier' and the grep alternation includes it, so a server echoing the accepted node back could false-positive as PROVEN. Add refusal tests, wire just test into CI, and tighten the probe detection to structured refusal output.

title: quarantine planes are design-only: inferred facts are not routed to a low-trust plane
description: docs/design/ingress.md 53-63 defines crew:records/crew:declared/crew:inferred/code:* with lattice trust labels, but zero non-doc references exist — no script names a graph, no shape targets one, no query has a GRAPH clause. An inferred-tagged node lands exactly where an observed one does; quarantine is currently skill discipline only. Provisional D (docs/patents/provisional-grounding-cluster.md section 3.3) discloses the enforced router as the primary contemplated embodiment: gate derives target plane from sourceKind. Implement the routing plus quipu lattice labels on the planes.

title: shapes: code-entity shapes do not require sourceKind — seed writes are untagged in the graph
description: docs/design/ingress.md rule 2 says every fact carries camayoc:sourceKind from the first load, but none of the 7 NodeShapes in shapes/code-entities.ttl (CodeModule, CodeSymbol, Document, Section, Bundle, Commit) requires it. The seed_knowledge.sh walk is therefore untagged in the graph; 'observed by construction' exists only as prose (seed_knowledge.sh:10-12). Either extend the tag to code-entity shapes or record the exemption as a deliberate, documented boundary.

title: Competency-gap detection: a question resolving to no competency question is an ontology gap
description: quipu docs/design/semantic-grounded-edit-policies.md, Further applications #6. Embed the competency-question suite; an incoming question whose best match falls below threshold is reported as NO COVERAGE — an ontology gap surfaced as its own outcome, never silently answered from the nearest term. The Empty/Partial/Full discipline applied to the ontology's own reach; gaps become candidate beads for new competency questions. Stage-1 advisory under the identify-and-inform-before-refusing ordering.

title: Settled-decision collision: similarity-check new Decision episodes against crew:declared before the write
description: quipu docs/design/semantic-grounded-edit-policies.md, Further applications #2. Before an agent's Decision episode lands, compare its embedding against standing human decisions in crew:declared; a match above threshold surfaces 'duplicates or conflicts with a settled decision' as advisory or escalation BEFORE the write. Convention memory made enforceable: the store notices re-litigation. Same disciplines: score/threshold/model/corpus-watermark in the verdict, nonzero OperatingPoint, advisory/escalate only, recorded facts land sourceKind=inferred. Depends on the quarantine planes existing (camayoc-s0h) and the grounding vocabulary (quipu-3aj, quipu tracker).

title: idempotency rule (branch on outcome, never count) not followed by camayoc's own scripts
description: skills/camayoc/SKILL.md 52-54 teaches agents to branch on outcome, never count; seed_knowledge.sh:67-69 parses count and conforms for its status line, and no script branches on outcome. ingest_metrics.py achieves convergence differently (deterministic aegis:contentHash, byte-stability tested). Align the scripts with the discipline they teach, or document why the seed path is exempt.

title: promotion out of crew:inferred is unimplemented (authority-gated graph move)
description: docs/design/ingress.md 109-111 defines promotion as a governed graph move requiring authority over the target plane; skills/camayoc/SKILL.md 82-83 states the agent-facing rule. No implementation exists. Depends on the quarantine planes existing first (camayoc-s0h). Note shapes/code-entities.ttl uses 'promotion' for an unrelated bobbin-to-quipu mechanism — naming collision worth resolving when this lands.
